visualRubricRecommendation.status: Proposed MS0 protocol; no current creative acceptance
visualRubricRecommendation.scoring: For each of the ten plan dimensions record pass/fail/not-assessable and located encoded frame(s)/shot/interval. A total numeric score must not compensate for a causal/mechanical/readability failure. Keep human review distinct from technical gate.

dimensions.evidence: Entry/mid/exit oblique angles reveal actual solid side surfaces; no plane-only proxy.

dimensions.name: Real slots
dimensions.evidence: Slot openings and rivet travel relationship visible in designated macro proof states; authored mesh/analytic relationship and encoded images.

dimensions.name: Readable blade curvature
dimensions.evidence: Silhouette and highlight remain coherent through camera motion; encoded comparison to frozen reference views.

dimensions.name: Bevel highlights
dimensions.evidence: Bevel highlights present and material-separated; not clipped glare obscuring hook/contact.

dimensions.name: Material separation
dimensions.evidence: Blade/hook/rivets/housing/contact surfaces individually identifiable at proof holds; final encode and declared reductions.

dimensions.name: Contact shadow
dimensions.evidence: Contact state has coherent grounding/shadow, with no unexplained floating gap; scene state and encoded proof.

dimensions.name: Visible causal contact
dimensions.evidence: Contact-face/state/travel analytic expectation across all relevant frames plus human causal reading at normal playback; label terminology separately resolved.

dimensions.name: Stable framing
dimensions.evidence: Required surfaces/anchors remain in frame through approach/hold/return; clearance and cuts explicit; random/reverse-seek invariance.

dimensions.name: Readable labels and captions
